title: BOX OF VINTAGE GLASSWARE
reason: Possible Bohemian gilt enamelled green glass hookah base plus several decent Murano style pieces, could total $100 to $250 if the green bottle is old.
findings: Mixed art and pressed glass. The best piece looks like a dark green hookah (narghile) base or bottle with gilt arabesque tracery, white enamel dots and portrait or landscape style medallions, in the Bohemian style made for the Middle East market (c.1880 to 1920) if old, though it could be a later copy. Also: rainbow banded globular bowl (Murano or Empoli style), orange cased satin vase, green and white latticino ruffled dish with twisted cane handle, two millefiori paperweights (Italian Murano style), one modern speckled studio paperweight with a blue fan, marigold carnival glass dish lid (lid only), frosted green flower frog, miniature green cup and saucer, green bowl with a metal rim, pale blue opaque cup and a green bubbly flask. No signatures, labels or maker marks readable in any of the 4 photos.
condition: Green metal-rimmed bowl shows crack or repair lines; the carnival piece is a lid only; gilding on the green bottle looks mostly intact with light rubbing; bases not shown, so chips and pontil damage are unknown.
rescore_note: Mixed art glass. The gilt enamelled green hookah base is roughly even odds of being old Bohemian, the rest is Murano style and pressed glass of modest value, so mid $80 to $200 band. General knowledge, no web check.
